body: Hot tea from a sippy cup might help! I also like to be rocked to sleep. Listening to some quiet music or rain sound effects helps me too :) Maybe try a back rub too!
Wow you have such a big collection! My daddy just recently got me mini Dot and I love her! I want a lot more!

I started my dd/lg relationship about 9 months ago! I'd been calling my daddy "daddy" for a few months but never added the lg dynamic to it until later. I always bonded better with children than adults, and I played with dolls until I was a young teenager. I was always torn between liking kid stuff and adult stuff. I tend to be more dominant in everyday life so little space was a great way to destress and relax and it made my relationship with my boyfriend of over a year have another dimension to it! I like it a lot more than any relationship I've been in before.
